name: Ahrefs
description: An SEO data and analytics platform providing keyword research, site auditing, backlink analysis, and ranking tracking via API v3.

evidence.claim: Ahrefs API v3 allows pulling data from Site Explorer, Keywords Explorer, SERP Overview, Rank Tracker, Site Audit, Brand Radar, Social Media Management, and Content Helper endpoints.
API keys are passed in the Authorization header as Bearer tokens: Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY.
Ahrefs API is available on eligible paid plans, with limited free test queries available on other plans.

notes: API v3 requires an API key passed via the Authorization Bearer header. While there are limited free test queries, full API usage requires an eligible paid Ahrefs plan.
